scope: Independent SQLite and RocksDB processes using the production Rocks provider, including candidate validation/activation. Rocks opens no SQLite database. Fresh application indexes; OS cache is not flushed.

measurement_notes.filesystem_caveat: Both backends use /tmp on overlayfs with fsync=volatile. This is not a durable WSL acceptance measurement.
measurement_notes.execution: No other builds, tests or benchmark workers launched concurrently. Backends alternate order; OS cache is not deliberately flushed.
